column2: Oh, and next time, I don't plan to cause you trouble over silly things.{wait}{clear}
You're going back to the Heavens?{wait}{clear}
Yes...{wait}{clear}But I will surely come back to you.{wait}{clear}...I will stay here as a human.{wait}{clear}
If you can't come back... it's all right...{wait}{clear}
There's no need to throw anything away for someone like me...{wait}{clear}
No... Rocus... I'll come back, I promise...{wait}{clear}We'll... meet again, Rocus.{wait}{clear}
I see...... I hope we meet again.{wait}{clear}

The name will be the default, Raviel.{wait}{clear}Also, your partner fairy is chosen at random from the eight.{wait}{clear}You can play from 1/1 to 1/31. The date is shown in the top left of the screen.{wait}{clear}Now, go and hear what Raphael has to say in the Palace of St. Azaria to begin the game.{wait}{clear}May fortune smile on you and on the heroes of Arcaya...{wait}{clear}
That's all for this preview. Please look forward to the rest of the adventure in the retail version.{wait}{clear}Until we meet again...{wait}{clear}
